_about: Standing decisions from Corentin. Every agent reads this file and must not raise these as problems. Updated 18 Oct 2026.

intentional_blocks.note: Notting Hill, Bayswater, Marylebone and Woolwich calendars are blocked on purpose. Blocked nights are not demand and not lost revenue: exclude them from opportunity and occupancy-gap findings.

special_setups.P14: Primrose Hill pricing (incl. the £500 minimum) is a deliberate special setup. Do not propose changing its min, base or min-stay; report its numbers only.

booking_visibility_booster: Booking.com Visibility Booster is raised on selected dates on purpose, so commission above 15% on those bookings is expected. Only flag commission that is above 15% AND not explained by the booster (ask before assuming).

length_of_stay_discounts.note: Same discounts on Airbnb and Booking.com (Airbnb screenshot 18 Oct 2026). A stay of 7-27 nights is expected 15% under the nightly price, 28+ nights 20% under. Only the gap beyond that is a leak.

linked_listings.P13: Smoobu 3064856 and 3090701 are ONE Shepherd's Bush flat. Their bookings are combined; nights blocked on one because the other is booked are bookings, not blocks.

property_facts.P05: St John's Wood (Abbey Rd): 4 bedrooms, 5 beds including a sofa bed (Corentin, 18 Oct 2026). PriceLabs shows 4 bedrooms since 19 Oct 2026; benchmark against 4-bed listings.
